fields.text: Preserved `G1`/`P1` ("zero user or agent cooperation required") throughout §1, §4, and §5.1 by keeping the milestone-gated `Stop` continuation (`NO_TOOL_CALL`, `executionNum == 0`) as the primary automatic Stage 1 mechanism while framing `memory_note` strictly as an optional mid-turn override that advances the conversation mark.

Retained `contract` as an alias for `convention`, `gotcha` as an alias for `external-behaviour`, and `recipe` as an alias for `procedure` so existing seeded ops and new `v2.2` entries remain schema-compatible.
